description: Repairs broken JSON: trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys, Python literals (True/False/None), NaN, comments, smart quotes and truncated documents. Built for the most common agentic failure mode — parsing slightly-wrong JSON from an LLM or a human. Use this when an agent needs to fix LLM-mangled, truncated or sloppy JSON. x402 price $0.01/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: dev_json_repair
title: JSON Repair
